short.text: Sen'Derrick Marks has proven himself an NFL starting defensive tackle: he was a starter on Jacksonville's interior line in 2013, dressed for all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games and was named a defensive captain for 2014. His quick first step, penetration and lateral pursuit can disrupt the pocket and the backfield. He is better as a one-gap pressure player than as an anchor against double teams.

transactions.text: Signed a four-year rookie contract with Tennessee
Signed a one-year contract with Jacksonville as a free agent
Re-signed with Jacksonville for four years (2014 to 2017)
